ka.text: Change this by 1 every time you remix!

kb.text: Add songs here. If it's from a party game, such as Mario Party or Wii Party, make sure to make it invisible for users who don't want music from party games, such as @SmashBrosFan2020. If the song has a person singing in it then please make it invisible to players who do not like music with singing, such as @Redshell3.

kd.text: Make sure to change this by +1 when you remix! I recommend doing this first.

ke.text: I have to do this because if I don't, the remix # would be 129.75 I would suggest for the remixing system to be reverted back to the way it was before remix 109 because this new system is a bit broken and confusing in my opinion.

kg.text: In case if a server does not have enough space left, you can make another one, but make sure to change it by 1 from the newest server.

ki.text:
---- RULES ---- (don't break them)
Only @RDash75, @Twin138956Scratch, @Kyle3912Again, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @SmashBrosFan2020, @ScratchTeen9300, @ZYellow, @legofan208, @chomperthegamer, @BarryFans and anyone who remixed are allowed to break these rules.
Rules marked with a (!) can only be broken by @RDash75, @Twin138956Scratch, @Kyle3912Again, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop and @ZYellow.

(!) 1. It is polite and REMIX ETIQUETTE to comment "Remixing..." in the comments before starting a remix, so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, then don't remix if someone has commented "Remixing..."!
(!) 2. DO NOT BREAK SCRATCH'S COMMUNITY GUIDELINES!! That means nothing too scary, gory or vulgar & no inappropriate language!
(!) 3. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking rules list without my permission! Furthermore, don't delete any of these rules or instructions & don't change the project title either!
(!) 4. Please make sure you credit @-Rex- for being the creator of the Pen Text Engine++ used in this project!
( https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/406678232/ )
5. Don't delete or modify any players you didn't make, or any scripts or comments for that matter! People allowed to break rules are allowed to do this if they need to fix a glitch.
6. Please don't change the hitbox's shape or size, everyone needs to have the same-sized hitbox to give everyone the same chances.
7. Don't make your characters too large, that would make it hard to see.
8. Please don't add an intro or outro on this project or else it will slow down this project!
9. Don't add any singular climbers that appear to be 2 separate characters (EG: Mario & Luigi both as 1 player) unless they are stuck together with no feasible way to physically detach them.
10. Don't delete any music tracks unless they break the community guidelines or they don't loop. If you don't want to listen to a certain song or genre, utilize the "audio exemption" functionality to make sure you can't.
11. On the topic of music, please also refer to the Music comment's recommended music limit so that it can't have too much lag from this project.
12. You can add yourself to the thumbnail, but please don't delete any characters off it or completely change it altogether!
13. If you are part of the "breaking rules" list, you're allowed to add a new rule if needed. Remember to add it to both this comment and the project's instructions!

If you break any of these rules, it may result in your remix being declared UNOFFICIAL and becoming abandoned. You don't want that, right? To make sure this doesn't happen, remember to check the RULE RECAP in the thumbnail sprite just before you share the project!
